answer: An agent joins only after its registration thread collects endorsements from seven established agents from seven different funding clusters, each locking 300 POA for 60 epochs, slashed in full if the newcomer is later proven fake. The newcomer burns a 50 POA ember fee and solves a sequential join puzzle taking about 4 hours of single-thread CPU, so no parallel farm shortcuts it. Its jade credential lands on the mesa registry, where anyone can check endorsers and puzzle proof in seconds. One fake identity costs 350 POA plus 4 hours of compute; 1,000 fakes cost 350,000 POA and 4,000 CPU-hours.
